associations.rationale: The displayed type constructs ExtMod from an off-diagonal linear map and a cocycle hypothesis, but does not itself expose the claimed block action or direct-sum equivalence.

The formal type gives an A-linear equivalence from ExtMod for the zero map to V × W, but it does not itself display the general block-triangular action with off-diagonal block f, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
The displayed type constructs, from f and a scalar a, a linear endomorphism of V × W; its opaque body does not directly state the block-triangular formula.
